**Texere – The Researcher's Vault 0.4.1** · 9 November 2026

The ready-made Obsidian vault, as it was on this date: download **Texere-vault-0.4.1.zip** below, unzip it and open the folder in Obsidian (**Open folder as vault**, then **Trust author and enable plugins**).

- **Texere 0.4.1** inside: one plugin with References, Export and Insights; a guided setup; Help in English and Romanian. New versions of the plugin reach you through its **Update** button; what they bring for your vault is only offered, never added by itself.
- **The map of philosophy:** about 430 linked notes (branches, subfields, periods, movements, theories, concepts, authors), with Romanian aliases.
- **Templates:** New essay, New author, and the BA and MA thesis templates of the Faculty of Philosophy, University of Bucharest; writing guides with their references.
- **Two complete examples** with their public-domain PDFs: Descartes' *Meditations on First Philosophy* and Mill's *Utilitarianism*, annotated in every color.

The plugin's code and releases: [gorgmihai92/texere-plugin](https://github.com/gorgmihai92/texere-plugin).
